examples.description: Structured company profile for a Norwegian org number

description: Resolve a Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (9 digits) into a structured company profile from Brønnøysund Enhetsregisteret: display name, form of organisation, NACE codes with descriptions, addresses, the dates of registration and dissolution, the `active` / `dissolved` status enum, the MVA-registered flag, and the role codes of persons in the public register (no names); never fødselsnummer or other national IDs. The backing REST route is POST /api/v1/brreg/company-profile. For deadlines and filing status, use get_company_summary; for the signaturrett / prokura role-code summary, use get_company_context instead. No sandbox mirror; it returns SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE under a sandbox bearer. Failure modes: COMPANY_NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_FAILED, ORG_NUMBER_INVALID_CHECKSUM, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE; a credential without `read:brreg` can't see the tool. Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call, prepaid (prices: the get_pricing tool or GET /api/v1/pricing). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/norwegian-company-register-search
description_nb: Slå opp et organisasjonsnummer og få en selskapsprofil fra Enhetsregisteret: navn, organisasjonsform, NACE-koder, adresser, status og rollekoder, aldri personidentifikatorer. For frister og innleveringsstatus, bruk get_company_summary i stedet; for signaturrett-/prokuraoppsummeringen, bruk get_company_context i stedet. Krever read:brreg. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing).

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (Brønnøysund Enhetsregisteret ID). Unlike the get_company_* tools, this input schema does NOT run the MOD-11 control-digit check — MOD-11 is enforced by the backing route, which returns ORG_NUMBER_INVALID_CHECKSUM (HTTP 400) when a well-formed 9-digit value fails it; correct the number rather than retrying the same one.

name: get_company_profile

outputSchema.description: Apier envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The Brønnøysund company profile: display name, organisasjonsform, NACE codes + descriptions, addresses, registration/dissolution dates, MVA flag, and person role codes from the public register (no names; never fødselsnummer or other national identifiers).

title: Company profile (Brønnøysund)
